notes.title: NEW Content And Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
[b]NEW[/b]

[list]
[*] Lil Qtip is now added to Endless Mode to join you in battle!
[*] Endless Mode now has a toggle in the menu for in-game abilities
[*] New Achievement Room can be accessed through the main menu
[*] A "Stats Board" is now accessible in the Achievement Room
[*] All settings except resolution are now saved
[*] Added achievement for getting on the dresser without using hover boards in Chapter 1
[*] Chapter 2 now has the addition of several more Qtips to help aid in battle
[*] Added an objective in Chapter 2 to build a turret operated by Qtips
[*] 
[/list]
[b]CHANGES[/b]

[list]
[*] Berf darts have increased speed
[*] Reworked elevation pad at cat tree for smoother and easier movement
[*] Optimized crates opening
[*] Optimized soldier grouping in Endless Mode
[*] Removed rat ability to climb kitchen island
[*] Updated "Cube" icon in Endless Mode to match Summon Qtip ability
[*] Sensitivity now has a slider in the settings
[*] Mini Boss in Endless Mode now always drops an upgrade when killed by the player
[*] Mini Boss now emits red particles
[*] XP reward for killing Mini Boss is much greater
[*] Dildos at spawn in Chapter 1 can now be picked up
[*] Lil Qtip can now be taken hostage by rat in Chapter 3
[*] Guidance arrows in Story Mode now emit a pulse for a few seconds when activated
[/list]

[b]BUG FIXED[/b]

[list]
[*] Couldn't open outlet after closing
[*] Rat animation stuck when returning to passive mode
[*] Berf balls knocked around idle entities
[*] Soldiers in Chapter 2 wonder when player is in elevated area
[*] Jeep sometimes wouldn't spawn
[*] Jeep sometimes wouldn't take damage
[*] Buying condom in Story Mode didn't update charging player coins
[*] Mini Boss in counted 2 kills instead of 1
[*] Mini Boss dropped upgrade even if player didn't kill it
[*] Mini Boss sometimes didn't take damage
[*] Rat Riders sometimes didn't take damage
[*] Soldiers would spawn during Clap-A-Cheek
[*] Ambient particles in Endless Mode wouldn't despawn
[/list]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update
notes.content:
[b]FIXES[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed missing prompt for screwdriver at light switch
[*]Fixed puzzle pieces falling through floor and not respawning Chapter 1
[*]Fixed CD accessible before completing objective 1
[*]Fixed space boss laser hitbox overstepping its boundaries
[*]Fixed jeep sometimes not taking damage from dart
[/list]

[b]CHANGES[/b]

[list]
[*] Added music when fighting jeep
[*] adjusted difficulty for Chapter 2
[*] Reduced total waves in space game
[/list]

notes.title: Official Release!
notes.content: Don't wait to get shlonging around. Hop on over to the store page and prepare yourself for a unique adventure!
